name: Inventory Lifecycle
purpose: Define physical spare demand, fulfillment, unit identity, RMA obligations, reviewed maintenance consequences, logistics, Fault Tags, warehouse loops and append-oriented correction without acquiring Task-lifecycle or communication authority.

decisions.decision: Spare Need is an SR-level BOM demand aggregate with preserved Device Part Unit contributors; local/external fulfillment does not automatically consume or delete the Need.
Stock is a query projection of eligible Spare Part Units; availability recommends choices but never auto-reserves/consumes physical units.
Spare Request is a local aggregate over one-or-more Spare Needs from one SR; Save Draft, Generate MSG and accepted Submission are distinct commands.
RMA is an obligation bridge, not a physical-unit container. No placeholder Spare Part Unit is fabricated before receipt.
Device Part Unit and Inventory Spare Part Unit are distinct physical identities; requested, promised, inbound, installed and returned BOM/serial facts remain role-specific evidence.

Task-to-unit allocation is planning only. After HLD-06 review, Inventory records an independent reviewed maintenance physical consequence and derives installation/removal/return relationships from that consequence.
Inventory lifecycle is append-oriented: corrections target exact events/relationships and rebuild current projections without rewriting original evidence or immutable identities.
Submission logistics snapshot is immutable requested intent; actual dispatch/pickup/delivery/receipt/custody are separate append-oriented logistics events.
Fault Tag is a first-class return-attempt aggregate. Submitted membership binds exactly one open RMA return obligation to exactly one reviewed physical return unit and may group across requests.

Warehouse receipt and final decision are separate per-membership facts: receipt does not close the obligation; explicit acceptance closes it; rejection preserves the failed attempt and keeps the obligation open for resend.
False-event correction, material correction replacement and genuine rejection resend are separate typed histories; resend never rewrites the prior attempt.
Every supported Inventory transition has a manual evidence-independent path; communication creates proposals only and Beta 1.0 exposes no manual attachment/upload control.

unresolved_here_by_design: exact inventory lifecycle/event relational schema and projection reducer interfaces
exact compatibility scoring/index strategy for Stock recommendations
exact tracking-ID presentation formats beyond accepted uniqueness/non-reuse
exact optional internal evidence-reference API representation
